title: Photo is prettier than it is in person.. DIY style set of x3 pump bottles.
text:
Photo is prettier than it is in person.. DIY style set of x3 pump bottles.. Although it looks the same.. it feels different in person. Ample labels included- however, user is to put these in place on the rounded surface which can be a tad tricky to get straight and even without bubbles on first try.. Not to mention, getting x3 identical bottles aligned to use in a row- turned out to be a little frustrating! x2 of our labels are peeling or crinkled in the corner from the beginning.. which, steam and water will exacerbate as time goes on in shower- and although it includes extras- they’re not duplicates of every label I need.

Black bottle is not transparent- so you’ll need to judge by weight or spot check as it runs low. Not a dealbreaker.. but, would be helpful feature if it was. Hard to detect in photo but aesthetic appear like glass and metal in photograph- and in person it presents like painted plastic- bc it is.. Truly, it’s what I wanted- I just thought it would feel more of a “authentic” presence in person. Tbh, these remind me of a child’s play toy.. we have a child’s kitchen play set that includes similar type bottle and feels the same.

Overall, pump does its job.. this has locking mechanism to close down for travel. Tipped on its side I’ve had no leaking filled with shampoo, conditioner and body wash. For price of $20- it’s high for x3 plastic pump bottles.. Product can perform as expected if your expectations are DIY style plastic bottles. Hoping info helps decision- stay safe everyone.
